frontier_selector.why: The presence of hypereosinophilia and FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene positive on RT-PCR strongly supports the diagnosis of Hypereosinophilic syndrome.

support_spans: FIP1L1-PDGFRA fusion gene positive on RT-PCR
elevated tryptase (33.7 ng/mL; reference range <11.5 ng/mL)
elevated vitamin B12 (>6000 pg/mL; reference range 211-911 pg/mL)
contradict_spans: Negative serologic tests for HIV, hepatitis A, B, and C

support_spans: Nodular infiltration of histiocytes with lymphocytes and eosinophils in upper dermis
asymptomatic red to brown macules and papules
some lesions had resolved spontaneously with residual hyperpigmentation
contradict_spans: Face, distal extremities, and mucous membranes were unaffected
